title: WaterColor "Far Niente" 120 Flatwood Street
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS: *Per Watercolor HOA, please include all guests aged 5 and older in your total count of adult guests to receive amenity and pool access wristbands. Sleep arrangements are provided as a courtesy and are not considered in the occupancy count.**This home is allowed 14 amenity access bands.**- Professionally decorated - Theater room with stadium seating- 7 adult bikes- Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkoutGuests staying in WaterColor will have access to the newly expanded WaterColor Beach Club. It features a new main pool and lounge area, second pool deck with additional lounge seating, and third pool with zero-entry, as well an enhanced WaterColor Grill, and new sunset bar, Costa Chica. All have scenic views of the Gulf of Mexico.DETAILS: 120 Flatwood Street is a stately home with its architecture and special features. This incredible Lake District home includes 5 bedrooms plus 2 additional bunk rooms and is sure to delight. Its large rooms and phenomenal detail are perfect for the entire family. Upon entering the home, you will be welcomed by the beautiful brick archway in the great room, along with its tall ceilings, rich flooring, and warm tones. You will be able to enjoy meals from a spectacular kitchen. The high-end appliances, granite countertops, stunning cabinetry, and the extra-large island make preparing that fabulous meal much easier. The kitchen, together with the living room and dining room, is comprised of an open floor plan that everyone can enjoy. A king bedroom can also be found on the first floor. This room features a flat-screen television, a walk-in closet, and a connecting bathroom with double vanities and a glass shower.On the second floor, you will encounter an enormous primary bedroom with a king bed and a queen sleeper, a flat-screen television, balcony access, and a connecting spa-like bathroom with double vanities, a walk-in glass shower, and a large tub. There are 2 more bedrooms on this floor, both featuring a queen bed with a single sleeper, flat-screen televisions, access to a balcony overlooking the park, and connecting bathrooms with single vanities and glass showers. Next, on the third floor, a bedroom with a queen bed, flat-screen television, and a connecting bathroom with double vanity and a glass shower greets you. Additionally, there is a bedroom with 2 bunks (4 twins) and a connecting bathroom with a single vanity and a glass shower. Lastly, there is another bedroom with 2 bunks (4 twins), a flat-screen television, and a bathroom with a single vanity and a shower.
